arxiv-2105-09871.title: Tuza’s Conjecture for Threshold Graphs Thanks: This research has received funding from the European Research Council (ERC) under the European Union’s Horizon 2020 research and innovation programme, grant agreements No. 714704 (Ł. Bożyk, T. Masařík, J. Novotná, and K. Okrasa), No. 648509 (A. Grzesik)
arxiv-2105-09871.creator: Marthe Bonamy, Łukasz Bożyk, Andrzej Grzesik, Meike Hatzel, Tomáš Masařík, Jana Novotná, Karolina Okrasa
arxiv-2105-09871.description: Abstract Tuza famously conjectured in 1981 that in a graph without k + 1 k+1 edge-disjoint triangles, it suffices to delete at most 2 ​ k 2k edges to obtain a triangle-free graph. The conjecture holds for graphs with small treewidth or small maximum average degree, including planar graphs.

arxiv-2105-10635.title: Two-stage Training for Learning from Label Proportions
arxiv-2105-10635.creator: Jiabin Liu, Bo Wang, Xin Shen, Zhiquan Qi, Yingjie Tian
arxiv-2105-10635.description: Abstract Learning from label proportions (LLP) aims at learning an instance-level classifier with label proportions in grouped training data. Existing deep learning based LLP methods utilize end-to-end pipelines to obtain the proportional loss with Kullback-Leibler divergence between the bag-level prior and posterior class distributions.

arxiv-2208-13834.title: Modeling and analysis of social phenomena: challenges and possible research directions
arxiv-2208-13834.creator: Federico Vazquez
arxiv-2208-13834.description: Abstract This opening editorial aims to interest researchers and encourage novel research in the closely related fields of sociophysics and computational social science. We briefly discuss challenges and possible research directions in the study of social phenomena, with a particular focus on opinion dynamics.

arxiv-2211-00506.title: Uniqueness of meromorphic functions that share Two Sets
arxiv-2211-00506.creator: Amit Kumar Pal 1 , Bikash Chakraborty 2 and Sudip Saha 3
arxiv-2211-00506.description: Abstract . In this note, we introduce a new kind of pair of finite range sets in ℂ \mathbb{C} for meromorphic functions corresponding to their uniqueness, i.e., how two meromorphic functions are uniquely determined by their two finite shared sets.

arxiv-2304-07210.title: Measuring Re-identification Risk Also affiliated with Data Sciences and Operations, University of Southern California. Also affiliated with Universidade Federal de Minas Gerais.
arxiv-2304-07210.creator: CJ Carey, Travis Dick, Alessandro Epasto, Adel Javanmard, Josh Karlin, Shankar Kumar, Andrés Muñoz Medina, Vahab Mirrokni, Gabriel Henrique Nunes, Sergei Vassilvitskii, Peilin Zhong
arxiv-2304-07210.description: Abstract Compact user representations (such as embeddings) form the backbone of personalization services. In this work, we present a new theoretical framework to measure re-identification risk in such user representations. Our framework, based on hypothesis testing, formally bounds the probability that an attacker may be able to obtain the identity of a user from their representation.

arxiv-2307-06908.title: Generating Benchmarks for Factuality Evaluation of Language Models
arxiv-2307-06908.creator: Dor Muhlgay Ori Ram Inbal Magar Yoav Levine Nir Ratner
arxiv-2307-06908.description: Abstract Before deploying a language model (LM) within a given domain, it is important to measure its tendency to generate factually incorrect information in that domain. Existing methods for factuality evaluation of LLM generation focus on facts sampled from the LM itself, and thus do not control the set of evaluated facts and might under-represent domain specific or rare facts.

arxiv-2310-18455.title: Approximate Heavy Tails in Offline (Multi-Pass) Stochastic Gradient Descent
arxiv-2310-18455.creator: Krunoslav Lehman Pavasovic, Alain Durmus, Umut Şimşekli
arxiv-2310-18455.description: Abstract A recent line of empirical studies has demonstrated that SGD might exhibit a heavy-tailed behavior in practical settings, and the heaviness of the tails might correlate with the overall performance. In this paper, we investigate the emergence of such heavy tails.

arxiv-2409-12575.title: Deep Transfer Hashing for Adaptive Learning on Federated Streaming Data
arxiv-2409-12575.creator: Manuel Röder, Frank-Michael Schleif
arxiv-2409-12575.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Manuel Röder, Frank-Michael Schleif. This extended abstract explores the integration of federated learning with deep transfer hashing for distributed prediction tasks, emphasizing resource-efficient client training from evolving data streams. Federated learning allows multiple clients to collaboratively train a shared model while maintaining data privacy - by incorporating deep transfer hashing, high-dimensional data can be converted into compact hash codes, reducing data transmission size and network loads.

arxiv-2501-14774.title: Achieving Carbon Neutrality for I/O Devices
arxiv-2501-14774.creator: Botao Yu, Guanqun Song, Ting Zhu
arxiv-2501-14774.description: Abstract Achieving carbon neutrality has become a critical goal in mitigating the environmental impacts of human activities, particularly in the face of global climate challenges. Input/Output (I/O) devices, such as keyboards, mice, displays, and printers, contribute significantly to greenhouse gas emissions through their manufacturing, operation, and disposal processes.

arxiv-2505-05493.title: FTNILO: Explicit Multivariate Function Inversion, Optimization and Counting, Cryptography Weakness and Riemann Hypothesis Solution equation with Tensor Networks
arxiv-2505-05493.creator: Alejandro Mata Ali
arxiv-2505-05493.description: Abstract In this paper, we present a new formalism, the Field Tensor Network Integral Logical Operator (FTNILO) , to obtain the explicit equation that returns the minimum, maximum, and zeros of a multivariable injective function, and an algorithm for non-injective ones. This method extends the MeLoCoToN algorithm for inversion and optimization problems with continuous variables, by using Field Tensor Networks.

arxiv-2508-10537.title: Computing the Fréchet Distance When Just One Curve is c c -Packed: A Simple Almost-Tight Algorithm
arxiv-2508-10537.creator: Jacobus Conradi, Ivor van der Hoog, Thijs van der Horst, Tim Ophelders
arxiv-2508-10537.description: Abstract We study approximating the continuous Fréchet distance of two curves with complexity n n and m m , under the assumption that only one of the two curves is c c -packed. Driemel, Har-Peled and Wenk [ 21 ] studied Fréchet distance approximations under the assumption that both curves are c c -packed.

arxiv-2512-03482.title: Kakeya-Nikodym norms of Maass forms on U ⁡ ( 2 , 1 ) \rm{U}(2,1)
arxiv-2512-03482.creator: Jiaqi Hou
arxiv-2512-03482.description: Abstract . Let ψ \psi be a Hecke-Maass form with a large spectral parameter on a compact arithmetic complex hyperbolic surface. We apply the amplification method to obtain a power saving over the trivial bound for the Kakeya-Nikodym norm of ψ \psi .

arxiv-2601-22628.title: TTCS : Test-Time Curriculum Synthesis for Self-Evolving
arxiv-2601-22628.creator: Chengyi Yang, Zhishang Xiang, Yunbo Tang, Zongpei Teng, Chengsong Huang, Fei Long, Yuhan Liu, Jinsong Su
arxiv-2601-22628.description: A 2026 arXiv research paper by Chengyi Yang, Zhishang Xiang, Yunbo Tang, Zongpei Teng, Chengsong Huang, Fei Long, Yuhan Liu, Jinsong Su. Test-Time Training offers a promising way to improve the reasoning ability of large language models (LLMs) by adapting the model using only the test questions. However, existing methods struggle with difficult reasoning problems for two reasons: raw test questions are often too difficult to yield high-quality pseudo-labels, and the limited size of test sets makes continuous online updates prone to instability.

pmc-11692708.title: SLEEP DISTURBANCES AND PAIN ON DEPRESSION IN OLDER ADULTS WITH AND WITHOUT ALZHEIMER’S DISEASE
pmc-11692708.creator: YingHua Wu, Benjamin Hougaard, Bárbara Gómez Cáceres, Jamie Kiefer, Rowena Gomez
pmc-11692708.description: Pain is associated with depression and sleep disturbance in older adults (OAs), including those with Alzheimer’s disease (AD; Cao et al., 2019; Tsai et al., 2021). However, limited research examines how various sleep disturbances moderate the relationship between pain and depression in OAs and those with and without AD.

pmc-12402270.title: A quadratic paradigm describes the relationship between phenotype severity and variation
pmc-12402270.creator: Abigail Mumme-Monheit, Grace E. Gustafson, Colette A. Hopkins, Raisa Bailon-Zambrano, Juliana Sucharov, Michael J. Lippincott, Gregory P. Way, Kathryn L. Colborn, James T. Nichols
pmc-12402270.description: In 1942 Waddington observed that phenotype variation among mutant animals is greater than in wild types. Here we update this observation to depict unexpected relationships between phenotype severity and variation. Using a zebrafish mef2ca allelic series representing a range in craniofacial phenotype severity, we tested the straightforward hypothesis that as phenotype severity increases, variation increases.

pmc-12430033.title: Recent Advances in the Synthesis and Applications of Nitrogen-Containing Macrocyclic Arenes
pmc-12430033.creator: Jianhang Hu, Wanhua Wu, Cheng Yang, Wim Dehaen
pmc-12430033.description: Macrocyclic arenes are rich-electron macrocycles bridged by methylene or methyl groups from aromatic rings substituted by hydroxyl or alkoxy groups. It has attracted great interest in host–guest chemistry and supramolecular self-assembly due to its clear cavity, adjustable structure and multifunctional binding ability.

pmc-12514263.title: Energy efficient clustering in industrial Iot using a quantum informed artificial hummingbird optimization algorithm
pmc-12514263.creator: S Rajkumar, R Gopalakrishnan
pmc-12514263.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). In Industrial Internet of Things (IIoT), Clustering facilitates the proves of organizing similar types of devices or data points into different clusters for the objective of enhancing resource utilization, network management and data processing. This clustering in IIoT helps in addressing the challenges that are associated with the process of handling network complexity, satisfying requirements of real-time processing and dealing with massive data volumes.

pmc-12587599.title: Simultaneous population genomics of hosts and their parasites with selective whole genome amplification
pmc-12587599.creator: Vincenzo A. Ellis, Angela Theodosopoulos, Ishika Sharma, Amélie Bardil, Martin Stjernman, Olof Hellgren
pmc-12587599.description: BackgroundGenerating parasite genomes is challenging when little of the DNA in infected host tissue is from the parasite. We used selective whole genome amplification (SWGA) to generate genomic data from wildlife samples of the avian haemosporidian Haemoproteus majoris (lineage PARUS1) and its host, the blue tit (Cyanistes caeruleus).

pmc-13247520.title: Two adult 46,XY sisters with female-like phenotype due to a novel homozygous LHCGR splice-site variant
pmc-13247520.creator: Marcela G Meirelles, Renata C Scalco, Juliana M Marques, José Lima Junior, Cristina F Bueno, Berenice B Mendonca
pmc-13247520.description: The luteinizing hormone/choriogonadotropin receptor (LHCGR) is essential for Leydig cell function, gonadal steroidogenesis, and male sexual differentiation. Loss-of-function variants in LHCGR are a rare cause of 46,XY differences of sex development (DSD). We report 2 46,XY adult sisters born to consanguineous parents, who presented with primary amenorrhea and absent secondary sexual characteristics.

pmc-13374147.title: Evaluation of cuspal deflection and microleakage of an incrementally packed versus a low shrinkage bulk-fill nanohybrid resin composite: an in-vitro study
pmc-13374147.creator: Rahma Fares Shaban, Rabab Ismail Abdel Fattah, Rehab Khalil Safy
pmc-13374147.description: BackgroundDespite the numerous advantages of using resin-based composite restorations, polymerization shrinkage and the resulting stresses remain significant concerns. These stresses are associated with two critical clinical outcomes: cuspal deflection and microleakage. This study aimed to evaluate the cuspal deflection and microleakage of an incrementally packed nanohybrid and a low-shrinkage bulk-fill resin composite.

pmc-13376471.title: Protocol: Community-Based Interventions to Improve the Health of People Experiencing Homelessness in High-Income Countries: An Evidence and Gap Map
pmc-13376471.creator: April M Ballard, Bethany Havas, Kylie R DeBoer, Larry Mason, Shannon Self-Brown
pmc-13376471.description: This is the protocol for a Campbell evidence and gap map. The objectives are as follows: to systematically retrieve, categorize, and map evidence on community-based health interventions for PEH in high-income countries, and identify gaps in the available evidence to inform a prioritized research agenda for health and homelessness.

pmc-13418751.title: Hematological Correlates of Hemoglobinopathies in Women of Reproductive Age With Anemia: A High-Performance Liquid Chromatography (HPLC)-Based Cross-Sectional Study
pmc-13418751.creator: Shanti Marandi, Manoj K Paswan, Anshu Jamaiyar, Deepali Tirkey, Sunil Kumar Mahto
pmc-13418751.description: Background: Anemia continues to pose a significant public health challenge, particularly among women of reproductive age. Despite ongoing nutritional intervention programs and iron supplementation strategies, the burden of anemia remains persistently high. In addition to iron deficiency anemia (IDA), inherited hemoglobin disorders such as β-thalassemia and sickle cell disease are important contributors to anemia.

pmc-13529679.title: Sustainable ammonia synthesis from nitrate wastewater via graphdiyne Mo–Cu–C≡C interfaces
pmc-13529679.creator: Zhaoyang Chen, Shuya Zhao, Qian Xiao, Yue Tian, Xiaofeng Lu, Yurui Xue
pmc-13529679.description: Electrochemical green ammonia (NH3) production using renewable electricity is sustainable but suffers from selectivity-activity-stability trade-off under industrial conditions. Here we report an atomic interface engineering strategy enabling in-situ assembly and coupling of hexaethynylbenzenes on molybdenum-copper oxidesto form an sp-hybridized Mo/Cu-C≡C heterointerface. It features dual d-orbital hybridization (Mo 4d-C 2p and Cu 3d-C 2p) weakening N–O bond by 36.

pmc-13567431.title: Structure-Based Screening Identifies Polyphenol Glucuronides as Cyclophilin D Ligands
pmc-13567431.creator: Annan Wu, Jie Zhang, Jing Zhao
pmc-13567431.description: (1) Background: The mitochondrial permeability transition pore (mPTP) contributes to mitochondrial dysfunction under pathological conditions. Cyclophilin D (CypD), a key regulator of sustained mPTP opening, represents an important molecular target. However, systematic strategies for selecting an appropriate CypD crystal structure for virtual screening and efficiently identifying CypD-binding natural polyphenols remain limited.

pmc-13604033.title: Superior clinical outcomes with combined intra‐articular platelet‐rich plasma and hyaluronic acid compared with hyaluronic acid alone in knee osteoarthritis: A prospective comparative study
pmc-13604033.creator: Trifon Totlis, Vlasiοs Achlatis, Panagiotis‐Konstantinos Emfietzis, Dimitris Tsigenopoulos, Mikail Chatzivasiliadis, Vassilis Ediaroglou, Stavros Savvakis, Efthymios Papasoulis, Ioannis Terzidis
pmc-13604033.description: PurposeAlthough platelet‐rich plasma (PRP) and hyaluronic acid (HA) are widely used for knee osteoarthritis (KOA), it remains unclear whether combining them provides greater benefit than HA alone. This study compared the efficacy and safety of three combined injections of PRP and high molecular weight (HMW) HA to three injections of HMW HA alone in patients with KOA.
